name: ue-driver
summary: Shell commands to compile the project's C++, run editor Python unattended, and run the game unattended with its log checked for errors.
adapt: Add Saved/ to .gitignore if it is not there: logs go to Saved/Logs/gam3.
If the engine is not in the launcher's default location, set UE_ROOT to the engine root.

verified.how: Installed into a fresh C++ project. ue_build.mjs compiled it and refused while an editor had the project open. ue_game.mjs ran a built level under the blind, agent and human profiles and reported readiness, shots and log problems; --shots under blind was refused. slots.mjs: three runs started together with GAM3_MAX_ENGINES=2 queued and all finished. ue_python.mjs was run for 0.1.0 and not again. Windows and Linux were not run.
